posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: I am pleased to nominate Grayson Lambert to serve as Judge on the United States District Court for the District of South Carolina. Grayson is currently Chief Legal Counsel to Governor Henry McMaster and, previously, was a partner at a respected law firm, and clerked for Judge Dennis Shedd of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit. A proud graduate of the University of Virginia and Duke University School of Law, Grayson will be an excellent addition to the Federal Bench in South Carolina. Congratulations Grayson! President DONALD J. TRUMP
